topStories.headline: Semiconductor Selloff Deepens: Nvidia Down 5%, AMD Down 8%, SMH Drops 4%
topStories.summary: A broad-based chip rout extended Monday as the VanEck Semiconductor ETF fell 4% — taking its one-month decline past 9% — with Jim Cramer flagging 'monstrous, motivated and often margined' sellers behind an intraday reversal that proved hard to arrest.
topStories.marketImpact: NVDA ↓ ~5%, AMD ↓ ~8%, INTC ↓ ~3.5%, AVGO ↓; SMH ↓ 4%; contagion spreads to Asian chipmakers at Tuesday open; SK Hynix (SKHY) Q2 results today a key sentiment pivot

topStories.headline: FOMC Begins July Meeting; Rate Hold at 3.50–3.75% Widely Expected as Inflation Stays at 4.2%
topStories.summary: The Fed's two-day July meeting kicks off today with Chair Kevin Warsh set to announce the decision Wednesday at 2:00 PM ET; markets price near-certainty of a fifth consecutive hold, though June's hawkish projections signal a higher-for-longer path.
topStories.marketImpact: Rate-sensitive sectors on hold watch; US 10Y at 4.67%; any dovish surprise → TLT ↑, QQQ ↑; hawkish tone → yields ↑, equities ↓; no new dot plot released this meeting

topStories.headline: Boeing, Ford, and Visa All Report Q2 Earnings Today; Boeing Enters with $695B Backlog
topStories.summary: Boeing reports at market open with a record $695B backlog and a 14% YoY delivery increase (171 aircraft); Ford reports after close with EPS expected at $0.36 on ~$45.7B revenue; Visa reports fiscal Q3 results at 5:00 PM ET.
topStories.marketImpact: BA watch (analysts see 29% upside; narrowed loss expected); F watch (tariff impact on margins key); V watch (payment volumes indicator of consumer health)

topStories.headline: SpaceX Shares Fall Below $135 IPO Price, Now Down 51% from Post-IPO Peak
topStories.summary: SpaceX stock closed below its June 12 IPO price for the first time, trading near $109 — more than 51% below its $225 post-IPO peak — as investors scrutinize the company's fundamentals and a Starship launch delay weighs on sentiment.
topStories.marketImpact: SPCX ↓; broader high-multiple tech and space names under pressure; adds to narrative of post-IPO hype deflation across 2026 listings

topStories.headline: SK Hynix Reports Q2 Earnings Today; HBM Supply to Nvidia Is the AI Memory Bellwether
topStories.summary: SK Hynix (SKHY) posts Q2 results today amid intense volatility — shares have swung between a 11% crash and a 14% rebound in a single week — as investors assess whether AI server memory demand can sustain premium HBM pricing.
topStories.marketImpact: SKHY earnings catalyst; beat → chip sector relief, NVDA ↑, MU ↑; miss → accelerates broader semiconductor selloff; Korea KOSPI chipmakers correlated

topStories.headline: Nikkei 225 Tests 63K–67K Range as FOMC, BOJ, and Earnings All Converge This Week
topStories.summary: Japan's benchmark fell 1,839 points (2.77%) to 64,584 Friday, led by SoftBank (-7.6%) and Renesas (-7.2%), as uncertainty mounts from this week's simultaneous FOMC (July 28–29) and BOJ (July 30–31) meetings alongside peak earnings season.
topStories.marketImpact: JP225 ↓ pressure; JPY near ¥164/USD; SoftBank (9984.T) exposed to rate path as leveraged tech investor; Advantest (6857.T) earnings Thursday a key AI equipment read

topStories.headline: BYD Officially Launches 'Racco' Kei EV in Japan Today, Targeting Suzuki's Wagon R
topStories.summary: Chinese EV giant BYD launched its Racco kei-class electric vehicle in Japan on July 28 — priced at ~¥2M ($12,200) after subsidies with 320km range — directly challenging Suzuki's best-selling Wagon R in Japan's most competitive automotive segment.
topStories.marketImpact: 1211.HK (BYD) ↑ on overseas expansion; 7269.T (Suzuki) ↓ competitive pressure; BYD's 70–80 Japan dealerships vs. Suzuki's 1,000+ remains a distribution constraint to watch

topStories.headline: China's June Exports Surge 27%, Fastest Since 2021, on AI Hardware and Tariff Rush
topStories.summary: China's exports jumped 27% YoY in June — the strongest pace since October 2021 — driven by surging global demand for AI infrastructure hardware and a rush by manufacturers to front-run anticipated US tariff increases; economists lifted 2026 GDP growth to 4.6%.
topStories.marketImpact: 9988.HK, 0700.HK broadly supported; CNY stable; FXI ↑ on growth outlook; supply chain momentum for Chinese AI hardware exporters; US tariff risk remains on the horizon

topStories.headline: Hang Seng Rebounds 1% to 25,207 as Oil Crash and Easing Geopolitical Fears Lift Sentiment
topStories.summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index recovered Friday's 1% loss on Monday, closing at 25,207, as technology and financial stocks led the rebound; easing Middle East tensions after the US-Iran hostility pause helped broader risk appetite.
topStories.marketImpact: 9988.HK, 0700.HK ↑ short-term; oil price stabilization supports Asian sentiment; Tuesday open at risk from US chip stock contagion; Shein HK IPO progress continues to underpin IPO pipeline optimism
